title: Misleading photo and item size
text: Misleading photo and item size. The photo you see when you buy, shows two. But you only get one. The size is incorrect as shown. If you put it up against a real brick post, it is half the size. I like the item, just be warned that it is smaller than shown and you only get one for the price. NOT a good deal after-all. Buy something else people. You have been warned.
